chunks: Al-Kahili narrated from him, peace be upon him, that he said:
A woman in ihram may wear all jewelry except conspicuous earrings and a conspicuous necklace.

key_terms.الْمَشْهُورَ: that which is conspicuous or prominent
key_terms.الْمَشْهُورَةَ: that which is conspicuous or prominent
key_terms.الْمُحْرِمَةُ: a woman in the state of ihram

ai.seo_question: What jewelry may a woman wear while in ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning what a woman may wear while in the state of ihram. It permits jewelry in general for a muhrimah, while excluding earrings and necklaces that are conspicuous and well-known as adornment.
